legacyAppEngine._what: How the web app turns answers into eligible products. Read from the shared bundle of the Manual app (same owner and code base as Voy), copy of 29 Dec 2025 in the Portuguese Web Archive. See src/arquivo/engine-excerpts.txt for the code itself. Not confirmed on today's Voy app, which could not be opened.
legacyAppEngine.questionnaireShape: questionnaire = { products: [product codes], steps: [ { questions: [ { id, question, type, answers:[{value,text,nullifying}], defaultAnswer (the current answer), required, rejectCondition, productExcludeCondition, parentQuestion, parentQuestionCondition, attributes, conditionals } ] } ] }
rules: Start with every product code listed on the questionnaire(s).
For each question: if it has a rejectCondition (answer values joined by '|||') and the chosen answer is one of them, the eligible list becomes EMPTY (the 'You aren't eligible' screen).
Otherwise remove the product codes that productExcludeCondition lists for the chosen answer.
At the end remove the placeholder product 'hair-consultation'.
A question with parentQuestion is shown only when the parent's answer equals (or includes) parentQuestionCondition.
questionShowCondition / questionHideCondition and 'conditionals' are JSON Logic rules run against all answers; conditionals swap in a different question definition when true.
The quiz state (answers, changedAnswers, eligibleProducts, inEligibleProducts, userPreferredProduct, aliasMapping) is kept in the browser's local storage under 'quiz'.
Adding a product to the cart sends productCode, variantCode, consultationAnswers and changedAnswers.
Product-first route: /n/hair-loss/quiz?atc=true; if userPreferredProduct.shouldSwap is true the app adds &swap=true (the chosen product is swapped for an eligible one).
